widgetTool.name: show_callback_form
widgetTool.description: Shows a callback request form on chat when the office is closed, to collect the callback number for create_callback_ticket. The visitor types the number into the form; then call create_callback_ticket with the same reason and that number. No spoken pacing is needed. Call shape: name is always cx-show-callback-form and all card fields go inside payload.

name.description: Always exactly cx-show-callback-form (the card element this tool renders).

prompt.description: Short line shown above the form.

reason.description: Why a callback is offered: after_hours or degraded.

payload.description: The card data. Put every card field inside this object.

textResponseConfig.textResponseInstruction: Ask for the callback phone number in plain text.
